summary: Harlan County, KY tower NHLR-registered in 2014; its only condition report (Aug 2014) finds it rusted with most stairs and cab floor gone. Build date and owner not in sources.

facts.status_note: Standing as of the August 2014 Register visit report, heavily rusted with most wooden stairs and cab floor gone; no later report found

events.note: Visit report dated August 6, 2014, by Robert Wittenback: rusty, needs paint, most wooden steps and cabin floor gone, nearby electronic sites encroaching, not staffed
Registered September 2, 2014; nominated by Robert Wittenback

notes_for_editor: Low confidence. One substantive source: the Register entry with its August 2014 visit report. The Forest Lookouts page for Chunklick has only a county header. Two searches for the tower's history found only the Beschman (Putney) Fire Tower on Pine Mountain in Harlan County, a different tower; not linked here. No build date, height, administrator, access level or post-2014 report found. The 2014 photo credited to Robert Wittenback was not captured (no image URL in the cache). 'Chunklick' may be a place name; unverified. No corrections to the current record.
